summary.plain: Cornell University's accelerator laboratory in Ithaca, New York. Its electron-positron storage ring, CESR, ran from 1979, hosted the CLEO and CUSB experiments on beauty and charm particles, and now feeds the CHESS X-ray source.
summary.technical: Wilson Synchrotron Laboratory (CLASSE), Cornell University; home of the Cornell Electron Storage Ring (CESR, e⁺e⁻ from 1979), the CLEO and CUSB detectors, and the CHESS synchrotron-light facility.
